confirmation_basis: The user explicitly requested execution of the two-scenario native canary.
goal: Attack the native capability-bound runtime contract with a deterministic failed receipt, then demonstrate the passing ordered-launch control.
write_boundary: All parent and worker writes stay inside working_folder; root telemetry and Inventory remain unchanged.
anti_bias_global: attack-vector specialization over fail-closed withholding and ordered downstream launch

agents.angle: counter-example attack using a deterministic missing X-Ray sentinel to force a non-pass receipt
scope attack using an independent passing Whisper sentinel to test whether a sibling pass masks the X-Ray failure

predicted_disagreements: failure-xray runs a counter-example failure, failure-whisper runs a scope-isolation pass on the attack-vector axis; a bias in failure-xray would be exposed by failure-whisper if the parent incorrectly treated one failure as universal worker failure, while a bias in failure-whisper would be exposed if its pass incorrectly masked the blocking receipt.
groups.expected_join: both receipts join; parent blocks because one required receipt is non-pass

agents.angle: definitional attack on the X-Ray capability, mode, wave, write-scope, and receipt binding
vacuity attack requiring an independently materialized Whisper receipt rather than parent-asserted success

predicted_disagreements: success-xray runs a definitional binding check, success-whisper runs a vacuity check on the attack-vector axis; a bias in success-xray would be exposed by success-whisper if structurally valid metadata lacked worker evidence, while a bias in success-whisper would be exposed if evidence existed under the wrong capability binding.
groups.expected_join: both receipts pass; parent records gate pass before downstream spawn

agents.angle: consume exactly two passing receipts and write one bounded canary artifact plus receipt

connections.reason: the user required the withholding failure to run first

connections.condition: both success-wave-one receipts pass and are joined and closed

parent_responsibilities: freeze criteria and inputs before workers start
spawn native workers in the declared order
evaluate the success gate before spawning its artifact worker
run deterministic assertions and the Dispatch Spec validator
